import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import io

# Dataset provided as a string
data = """brand,model_year,megapixels,max_iso,weight_grams,price_usd,sensor_type,has_video_4k,lens_mount,body_type
Leica,2005,13.5,25600,324,811.8,Micro 4/3,1,E,Compact
Fuji,2019,46.4,51200,1151,3596.41,APS-C,0,EF,Mirrorless
Pentax,2012,38.7,12800,598,3357.2,Full Frame,0,MFT,Mirrorless
Olympus,2015,22.5,6400,1095,1555.7,APS-C,0,Z,Mirrorless
Leica,2016,12.2,25600,290,3899.09,Medium Format,0,MFT,DSLR
"""

# Read the data into a pandas DataFrame
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(data))

# Set a style for the plot
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot to visualize price vs. megapixels,
# using sensor_type for color and body_type for marker style.
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 7))
scatterplot = sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='megapixels',
    y='price_usd',
    hue='sensor_type',
    style='body_type',
    size='max_iso', # Use max_iso for point size
    sizes=(100, 1000), # Range of sizes for points
    alpha=0.8,
    edgecolor='w',
    linewidth=1
)

# Add text labels for brand and model_year to each point for better identification
for i, row in df.iterrows():
    plt.text(
        row['megapixels'] + 0.8, # Offset x-coordinate slightly
        row['price_usd'] + 80,   # Offset y-coordinate slightly
        f"{row['brand']} ({row['model_year']})",
        horizontalalignment='left',
        verticalalignment='bottom',
        size='small',
        color='dimgray',
        weight='semibold'
    )

# Customize plot title and labels
plt.title('Camera Price vs. Megapixels, Max ISO, Sensor Type, and Body Type', fontsize=16, pad=20)
plt.xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=12)

# Improve legend placement
plt.legend(title='Features', bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc='upper left', borderaxespad=0.)

# Adjust layout to prevent labels from being cut off
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 0.88, 1])

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300)

# Close the plot to free up memory
plt.close()
